eyebrow.zh: 记录 · 对比 · 看清

headline.zh:
看清你的 agent
每次工具选择的胜负
headline.en:
See which agent tool
actually won

sub.zh: 记录每次工具决策和结果，A/B 对比两次运行，立刻看到哪个工具赢了、哪个拖了后腿。
sub.en: Record every tool decision with its outcome, A/B compare two runs, and instantly see which tool won and which held you back.

body.zh: 不再猜测 agent 为什么用了 grep 而不是 LSP —— 每次工具决策和它的结果都被记录下来，可追溯、可审计。
body.en: Stop guessing why your agent reached for grep instead of LSP — every tool decision and its outcome is recorded, traceable, and auditable.

body.zh: 把两次运行放在一起，按任务自动配对，输出一张 Markdown 表格 —— 哪个工具赢了、哪个输了、哪个打平，一目了然。
body.en: Put two runs side by side, auto-matched by task, and get a Markdown table — which tool won, which lost, which tied, all at a glance.

body.zh: 不需要你逐行翻日志 —— repick 直接告诉你哪个工具在哪个任务上拖了后腿，你决定下次要不要关掉它。
body.en: No need to read through logs line by line — repick tells you exactly which tool held you back on which task, so you can decide whether to turn it off next time.

sub.zh: 三个命令，从零到 A/B 对比表。MIT 开源，免费使用。
sub.en: Three commands from zero to an A/B table. MIT open source, free to use.

tag.zh: MIT 开源 · 由 SuperMarioYL 构建
tag.en: MIT open source · Built by SuperMarioYL
